_note: Hand-transcribed from the specimen images. Field keys are our own catalog FieldIds (src/domain/field-id.ts), so a score here reads directly as 'could OCR fill this required field'. `dl_number_box` is an EYEBALLED region on a 0-1000 scale, adequate for asking 'did the box land on the right field rather than a neighbour', NOT for tight IoU claims.
_provenance: Every value here was read off the specimen image by eye. None of it was copied from a recorded OCR `text` or `detections`, because grading an extractor against OCR output measures parsing, not reading, and would score a misread card as a success. `first_name` is the first given name as printed; a card that prints middle names on the same line is noted.
_multiline: A value is a LIST when the card prints it across two lines. Those come back as separate detections, so a concatenated string would score a correct read as a miss.

specimens.notes: Enhanced DL. Guilloche background plus a large diagonal SAMPLE overprint crossing the data fields. The licence number is printed TWICE — at `4d LIC#` and again at `5 DD` — so selecting its box by value alone crops the wrong half of the card.
Heavy security overlay: dove hologram over the ISS/EXP block, CS59 ghost text, SAMPLE vertical band.
Cleanest of the four. Expiry is labelled EPX, not EXP.
Lowest resolution (~178 dpi at card size). Ghosted repeat of the DOB digits over the portrait.
Name is one `1,2` stack: CARD on the first line, OREGON SAMPLE, SR on the second. The address code 8 sits beside the street line.
Licence number is labelled `4d Customer number`, spelled out. Name is a `1,2 Name` stack.

Pre-AAMVA, 1977. No numbered field codes anywhere: labels are words (IDENTIFICATION NO., BIRTH DATE, EXPIRES). Dates are two-digit years. The address spells the state out in full and gives no two-letter code.
Identification card, not a licence. The number is labelled `ID` and is an ID number, not a dl_number — the catalog does not derive dl_number from a state ID, so nothing in our schema holds it.
Identification card sharing the VA licence layout. `4d Customer number` holds an ID number, same caveat as ca_id_2010.

ICAO Doc 9303 Netherlands specimen passport. Dates transcribed as ISO, not as printed, since the visual field (`10 MAA/MAR 1965`) and the MRZ both round-trip to it. `passport_number` is read off the visual `documentnummer` field, which matches the MRZ document-number zone.
